module-1-product-starter-sheet-project.label: Module 1 Product Handoff Project
module-1-product-starter-sheet-project.summary: Build one product query that grows from a merchandising review into an operations-ready handoff.

mp-1-preview-product-sheet.title: Prepare the merchandising view
mp-1-preview-product-sheet.prompt: The merchandising team needs a compact review sheet. Return `name`, `category`, and `price` from `products`, in that order.
mp-1-preview-product-sheet.hint: Replace the all-columns view with only the fields the merchandising reviewer needs.

help.concept: A focused SELECT list should match the reader's immediate information needs.
help.hint_1: Use a focused SELECT list instead of returning every column.
help.hint_2: Run the query and confirm the result columns appear as name, category, price.

mp-1-preview-product-sheet.solutionCode:
SELECT
  name,
  category,
  price
FROM products;

sourceChecks.message: Use the `products` table in the FROM clause.
Select the required columns in the requested order: `name`, `category`, `price`.

mp-2-add-pricing-columns.title: Prepare the operations handoff
mp-2-add-pricing-columns.prompt: Warehouse operations will use the approved sheet next. Extend the same query so it returns `id`, `name`, `category`, `price`, and `stock` from `products`, in that order.
mp-2-add-pricing-columns.hint: Keep the approved merchandising fields, place `id` first, and add `stock` last.

help.concept: A cumulative project keeps the working query and extends it for the next stakeholder.
help.hint_1: Start from the working merchandising query without deleting its three fields.
help.hint_2: Add `id` at the beginning of the SELECT list and `stock` at the end.

mp-2-add-pricing-columns.starterCode:
SELECT
  name,
  category,
  price
FROM products;
mp-2-add-pricing-columns.solutionCode:
SELECT
  id,
  name,
  category,
  price,
  stock
FROM products;

sourceChecks.message: Use the `products` table in the FROM clause.
Select the required columns in the requested order: `id`, `name`, `category`, `price`, `stock`.

try_module_1_product_starter_sheet_proje.title: Preview the Product Sheet Fields
try_module_1_product_starter_sheet_proje.prompt: Before building the product sheet, create its base catalog view. Return `id`, `name`, and `category` from `products`.

sketch_project_brief.title: Project brief
sketch_project_brief.bodyMarkdown:
A small online store is preparing a product sheet for two teams.

First, merchandising needs a compact view for a catalog review: the product name, category, and price. Once that view is approved, warehouse operations needs the same working query expanded with the stable product id and current stock count.

You are not writing two unrelated queries. Build one useful result, keep it working, and extend it for the handoff.
